import tempfile, os
from miniconf.loader import load
from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    w=lambda n,t: open(os.path.join(d,n),'w').write(t)
    w('a','@include b\n'); w('b','@include a\n'); w('s','@include s\n'); w('m','@include nope\n')
    w('o','x = 1\n@include p\ny = 1\n'); w('p','x = 2\ny = 2\n')
    for f in 'asm':
        try: load(os.path.join(d,f))
        except ConfigError as e: print('ok',e)
    c=load(os.path.join(d,'o')); print(c.get('x'),c.get('y'))
EOF
